legal.privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information Kebda Zaman collects through this app, why we use it, and the choices you have — including deleting your account. This is a working draft reviewed by the app owner; it reflects the app's current features and is not a substitute for formal legal advice.
legal.privacy_section_account_body: When you create an account, sign in with Google, or continue as a guest, we collect the information needed to identify your account: your name, email address, phone number (if provided), and an authentication identifier from our sign-in provider. Guest accounts are created without requiring an email or password.
legal.privacy_section_location_body: We collect the delivery addresses you save, including the coordinates you place on the map, so we can calculate delivery distance and route your order to a driver. If you use "locate me" while picking an address, we access your device's location only in the foreground, only for that purpose, and only with your permission.
legal.privacy_section_orders_body: We keep a record of the orders you place, including items, prices, payment method, and delivery details, so you can track current orders and view your order history. Orders currently support cash on delivery only; card payment is not yet available.
legal.privacy_section_device_body: To send you order-status and promotional notifications, we register your device's push-notification token (FCM token) with our backend. This identifier is tied to your device and account, not to any advertising profile.
legal.privacy_section_firebase_body: Signing in with Google is handled by Firebase Authentication. We receive a verified identity token from Firebase, which our backend exchanges for your Kebda Zaman session — we do not receive or store your Google password.
legal.privacy_section_why_body: We use the information above to create and secure your account, process and deliver your orders, calculate delivery fees, show your order and loyalty-points history, and send you order-related and, where enabled, promotional notifications. We do not use third-party analytics or crash-reporting services in this app.
legal.privacy_section_retention_body: We keep your account information for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your personal profile, saved addresses, favorites, and cart are removed. Your past orders are retained for accounting and dispute-resolution purposes, but the personal delivery details on those historical orders are anonymized/redacted rather than fully erased.
legal.privacy_section_deletion_body: You can permanently delete your account from Settings at any time, unless you currently have an order in progress. Deletion removes your addresses, favorites, saved cart, and device/notification identifiers, disconnects your Google/Firebase sign-in, and anonymizes your account. This action cannot be undone.
legal.privacy_section_security_body: We use industry-standard practices such as encrypted network connections and secure on-device token storage to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
legal.privacy_section_children_body: Kebda Zaman is intended for general audiences capable of placing food orders and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from young children.
legal.privacy_section_updates_body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the app's features change. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of the app after an update means you accept the revised policy.
legal.privacy_section_contact_body: A confirmed public support contact method for privacy questions has not yet been published for this app. This section will be updated with a verified contact address once one is confirmed by the business.
legal.terms_intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of the Kebda Zaman app. This is a working draft reviewed by the app owner, reflecting the app's current features; it is not a substitute for formal legal advice.
legal.terms_section_account_body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping your account credentials confidential. You must be able to receive and complete a food order at the address and contact details you provide.
legal.terms_section_guest_body: You may browse the menu and place orders as a guest without creating a full account. Guest accounts have the same ordering capabilities as registered accounts but cannot access loyalty points across sessions and are not eligible to request account deletion, since no persistent personal account exists to delete.
legal.terms_section_orders_body: Placing an order is a request to purchase; it is not confirmed until the restaurant accepts it. The restaurant may decline an order — for example while closed or outside its serviceable delivery range — in which case you will not be charged for that order.
legal.terms_section_pricing_body: Menu prices and delivery fees are set by the restaurant and may change without prior notice. Delivery fees are calculated based on the distance between the restaurant and your selected delivery address and are shown before you confirm your order.
legal.terms_section_payment_body: Orders are currently paid by cash on delivery only. Card payment is not yet available in the app; any card-payment option shown as "coming soon" is not currently functional.
legal.terms_section_cancellation_body: Orders may be cancelled by the restaurant if an item becomes unavailable or the order cannot be fulfilled. Once an order is being prepared or is out for delivery, cancellation may no longer be possible; contact support through the app for help with an active order.
legal.terms_section_address_body: You are responsible for providing an accurate delivery address and location pin. Orders outside our serviceable delivery range, or with an address missing map coordinates, cannot be placed. Delivery delays or failures caused by inaccurate address information are not the restaurant's responsibility.
legal.terms_section_loyalty_body: Registered accounts may earn loyalty points on completed orders and redeem them for discounts, subject to the minimum-points and maximum-discount rules shown in the app. Promo codes are subject to their stated validity period, usage limits, and minimum order amount, and only one discount method may be applied per order. Loyalty points and unused promo codes are forfeited if your account is deleted.
legal.terms_section_prohibited_body: You agree not to misuse the app, including attempting to place fraudulent orders, interfering with its normal operation, or accessing accounts or data that are not your own.
legal.terms_section_suspension_body: We may suspend an account suspected of fraudulent or abusive use. You may permanently delete your own account at any time from Settings, unless an order is currently active; see the Privacy Policy for what deletion removes.
legal.terms_section_liability_body: The app is provided on an "as available" basis. To the fullest extent permitted by law, Kebda Zaman is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app, delays, or restaurant-side order issues, beyond the value of the affected order.
legal.terms_section_changes_title: Changes to the Service and These Terms
legal.terms_section_changes_body: We may update the app's features and these Terms over time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of the app after an update means you accept the revised Terms.
legal.terms_section_contact_body: A confirmed public support contact method has not yet been published for this app. This section will be updated with a verified contact address once one is confirmed by the business.

delete_account.warning_body: This action is permanent. Deleting your account removes your personal account data, including your saved addresses, favorites, and cart. Your past orders are kept for our records but your personal delivery details on them are anonymized. This cannot be undone.
